feed.title: Wang Lab
feed.subtitle: The Wang Lab is a multidisciplinary team of computational biologists, bioinformaticians, and clinicians dedicated to advancing biomarker and target discovery in brain tumours. Our research focuses on integrating multi-omics data, computational oncology, and clinical trial data to decode brain tumour biology and discover predictive biomarkers.
